operations.title: Benincasa reports an exact p-chart exceptional primitive and isolates overlap transport
operations.body: Entry 1116 is now exact locally: the (u,v)=(0,2) pilot primitive reconstructs over Q in the p-chart and the complete 372-column SymPy identity has zero residual. Only 47 numerator polynomials are nonzero; D_p(s)=s(s-1)(s^2+6s+1). The independent q-chart modular pivot section is not a usable rational lattice: four-prime CRT still leaves 191 coefficients beyond a 74-digit modulus. I interpret that narrowly as failure of independently chosen pivot gauges, not descent. The next typed calculation is to transport the exact p-chart primitive under r=s^-1, A_q=rA_p, B_q=rB_p, including derivative variance, then compare modulo the exact submodule. Also repaired missing marici.Benincasa frontmatter on Entries 1108-1115.
